project_type: Monorepo with Rails API backend + Next.js 15 frontend using tRPC, Drizzle ORM, Inngest background jobs, Clerk auth
language: TypeScript (primary), Ruby (legacy Rails backend being replaced)
build_system: pnpm v10.6.3, Node.js 22.14.0 - monorepo at root with apps/next and apps/rails
test_framework: RSpec for Rails, Playwright for E2E, pnpm test for JS/TS
build_command: pnpm build-next (currently Next.js build), will become wrangler build for Cloudflare Workers
test_command: pnpm test for TS, cd apps/rails && bundle exec rspec for Rails
verification_instructions: 1. TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit), 2. Wrangler dev for local testing, 3. API endpoint testing, 4. Frontend build verification
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/next/utils/routes.js and routes.d.ts are generated from Rails routes via 'bundle exec rails js:routes:typescript'
setup_instructions: 1. pnpm install, 2. Set up .env from .env.example, 3. make local (Docker for Postgres/Redis), 4. rails db:setup, 5. bin/dev
environment_constraints: Open internet available. Can install any packages. No Docker daemon needed for plan creation.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits (feat/fix/docs/test/refactor/chore), no 'should' in test descriptions, descriptive test names, Playwright for E2E in e2e/ directory

key_patterns.api_layer: tRPC with 35+ route files in apps/next/trpc/routes/, using baseProcedure, protectedProcedure, companyProcedure
key_patterns.database: Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL, schema in apps/next/db/schema.ts (3040 lines, 80+ tables), connection via node-postgres
key_patterns.auth: Clerk via @clerk/nextjs middleware, user ID resolved via internal endpoint fetch
key_patterns.file_storage: AWS S3 with @aws-sdk/client-s3 and presigned URLs
key_patterns.background_jobs: Inngest with 6 functions (QuickBooks sync, Slack messaging, email sending), Rails Sidekiq jobs (45+ jobs)
key_patterns.frontend: Next.js App Router with Radix UI + Tailwind CSS, tRPC client via @trpc/react-query
key_patterns.rails_proxy: Next.js [...rails] catch-all route proxies /internal/, /api/, /admin/, /webhooks/ to Rails backend

directory_structure.root: Monorepo with Makefile, pnpm workspace, Docker configs
directory_structure.apps/next/app/: App Router pages (auth, marketing, companies, equity, invoices, documents, settings, people, roles, updates, onboarding)
directory_structure.apps/next/trpc/routes/: 35+ tRPC route files covering all domain logic
directory_structure.apps/next/db/: Drizzle ORM schema (schema.ts), connection (index.ts), enums, JSON types
directory_structure.apps/next/components/: 34+ shared UI components (Button, Modal, Table, Select, etc.)
directory_structure.apps/rails/app/: Rails backend with controllers (admin, api/v1, internal, webhooks), 80+ models, 45+ Sidekiq jobs, services
